genuine200PercentZoom: NOT_RUN / BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. --force-device-scale-factor=2 did raise devicePixelRatio to 2, but the CSS viewport stayed 1424px, so the CSS-px-to-viewport relationship never changed: that is a high-DPI render, not page zoom. Device-pixel-ratio injection is an explicitly forbidden zoom substitute, so the two screenshots it produced were DISCARDED rather than mislabelled as zoom evidence.
canonicalRule: Every filename is unique and captured once against the implementation checkpoint above; all entries are CANONICAL and none is SUPERSEDED. A future competing capture for an existing slot wins only with a later timestamp; an unresolvable collision is AMBIGUOUS and withheld until adjudicated.
